_comment: Police (Session 6). Everything a wanted level sends after Shoumik. levels[stars - 1]: foot = officers on foot at once, armed = foot officers shoot (else they try to arrest with batons), swat = black-uniform officers (rifles, more health), cars = police pickups chasing (they ram), carColor = paint of those pickups, roadblocks = road blocks ahead of him while he drives, helicopter = one police helicopter. Counts are multiplied by data/quality.json -> police and rounded. No real police logos or names are used.

spawn._comment: Where new units appear: between minDistance and maxDistance metres from Shoumik, preferably out of view. every = seconds between new units. despawnDistance = units further than this are removed (and replaced closer).

officer._comment: Officers on foot. speeds in m/s. arrestReach = how close an officer must be to arrest; bustSeconds = how long he must hold Shoumik (on foot and slower than bustMaxSpeed, or in a vehicle slower than bustVehicleSpeed) for BUSTED. sightRange = how far officers can see him (walls block). shootRange, fireEvery (s, random range), accuracy = chance a shot hits at 10 m (less further away and when he sprints), damage = health per hit, swatDamage for the black-uniform unit. meleeEvery / meleePower = baton hits. downSeconds = time on the ground after a punch or car hit.

car._comment: Police pickups. type = vehicle type from data/vehicles.json; types = (Roadmap 2 S2) a list to pick from for each new car (a name twice = twice as likely), e.g. pickups and jeeps. ramSpeed = target speed when close (m/s); cruise = speed when far. leadSeconds = they aim where Shoumik will be this many seconds ahead. exitDistance = when Shoumik is on foot this close and the pickup has stopped, its officers get out (crew of them). sirenEvery = seconds between siren blasts. stuckSeconds/reverseSeconds = backing off after getting stuck.

roadblock._comment: Road blocks (4+ stars, only while Shoumik drives faster than minPlayerSpeed). Two pickups across the road distance metres ahead, with officers beside them. every = seconds between blocks; lifeSeconds = how long one stays.

helicopter._comment: Police helicopter (5 stars). height above ground (m), orbitRadius around Shoumik, speed (m/s), fireEvery (s), accuracy, damage per hit, health. spotlight = the light cone it points at him.

archetypes._comment: How officers look (same format as data/pedestrians.json archetypes; colour lists are in palettes below or in pedestrians.json). extras: gun = a pistol / rifle in the hand, vest = a black protective vest.
